## Discovery placeholder (must replace)
Replace Discovery field map with real discovery:
- SerpAPI / DataForSEO / ValueSERP Google Jobs using `searchQuery`
- or HTTP Request to a board + HTML extract

Map real fields only: title, company_name, external_link/url, location, description, category/categoryHint

Do not invent example.com apply links — preprocess drops missing/blocked hosts.

After ingest accepts jobs, JobsHub auto-runs daily alerts (Telegram/email).
Set n8n env JOBSHUB_INGEST_KEY = JobsHub INGEST_API_KEY.

meta.description: Skeleton: schedule → multi-field queries → (wire Google SERP/board) → preprocess → JobsHub ingest. Set env JOBSHUB_INGEST_KEY. No example.com placeholder jobs.
